# Psalm 109 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 109:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** To-the-choirmaster. Of-David. A-psalm. O-God-of my-praise do-not be-silent,
- **LOGOS:** To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Be not silent, O God of my praise!
- **PNEUMA:** For the choir director. A psalm of David. God of my praise, don't stay silent!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** Wicked, lying people have opened their mouths against me — they're speaking lies about me.

- **PNEUMA:** Put an evil man in charge of him, and let an accuser stand at his right side.
